question: Does the official historical NFRDI carp article provide a survey-quality, waterbody-resolved fish record for Caliraya?

source.title: Utilization and Processing of Carp
source.publication: The Philippine Journal of Fisheries, Vol. 12, Issues 1-2, pp. 75-91
source.articleContext: The article says it was read at a Fisheries Forum on 17 June 1975. Its experiments used carp samples procured from commercial markets.

finding.textLocalityLead: The introduction identifies common carp as Cyprinus carpio, then says carps are found in Lake Lanao, Lake Buhi, Laguna de Bay, Ambuklao and Caliraya Dams, and Angat Reservoir.
finding.evidenceClass: Attributed historical text-locality statement; not an individually collected occurrence or survey result.
finding.waterbodyAssignment: The source's wording is retained as 'Caliraya Dams'. No separate alias or geometry crosswalk to the Caliraya-Lumot reservoir system was added.

limits: This is a utilization and processing article, not a fish survey or specimen catalog.
The article gives no Caliraya sampling station, collection date, gear, specimen voucher, or abundance estimate.
Its processing experiment samples came from commercial markets; the article does not link those samples to Caliraya.
The statement's 'now' refers to the historical article context, not present-day presence.
No item-specific open license or public-app reuse permission was displayed in the reviewed article PDF or page metadata.
nextAction: Use this only as a historical source lead. Seek a Caliraya field survey, voucher-linked occurrence, or dated fisheries table with explicit station and capture origin before adding a species assertion.
